differences.a_observable: Low-angle perspective on the yellow Recurly button.
differences.b_observable: High-angle, flatter perspective on the yellow button.
differences.fix: Lower camera height and increase pitch angle.

differences.a_observable: Shallow depth of field with blurred background elements.
differences.b_observable: Deep depth of field with sharp background elements.
differences.fix: Adjust camera aperture to blur background.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette darkening the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: Weak or absent vignette with bright corners.
differences.fix: Apply a stronger vignette in post-processing.

differences.a_observable: Warm, golden-yellow color on the Recurly button.
differences.b_observable: Cooler, greenish-yellow color on the Recurly button.
differences.fix: Shift the yellow material color toward orange.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and height to match the dynamic low-angle perspective of the reference video.
